references.text: Describes the wave offering (תְּנוּפָה) and the breastpiece given to Aaron and his sons as a perpetual right, which directly relates to the gifts mentioned in Num 18:11.
Refers to the waved breast and the raised thigh that are to be eaten by the priests, their sons and daughters in a clean place, paralleling the regulation on who may eat from these gifts.
Establishes rules of purity for those who are to eat from the holy offerings, corresponding to the requirement that all who are clean in the house may eat from it.
Defines who within the priest's household has the right to eat from the holy things, including daughters who return to their father's house.
Describes the waved breast and the raised thigh from the ordination offering as a perpetual right for the priests of the children of Israel.
The immediate context describing the holy gifts given to Aaron and his sons as a perpetual right.
Confirms that all holy offerings from the children of Israel are given to Aaron and his descendants as an everlasting covenant.
Reiterates that the Levites and priests shall live by the Lord's fire offering and inheritance, specifying which parts of the sacrifice belong to the priest.
